ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Employer and insurer contracts, Pilot and later stages need Pilot agreed and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Employer_insurer_contracts", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Proposal", 3, "Governance review", 4, "Pilot", 5, "Contract out", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 5, OR(NOT(Pilot_agreed__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Pilot agreed and Next step date before moving to Pilot.
